bio.text: Barry Moore was born and raised on a family farm in Coffee County, Alabama, and is a member of the U.S. House of Representatives.
He was recruited to run in 2010 and represented District 91 in the Alabama State House for eight years, chairing its Military and Veterans Affairs Committee.
After high school he served six years in the Alabama National Guard and Reserves, and he studied Agricultural Science at Auburn University.
He founded Hopper-Moore Inc., an industrial waste hauling company based in Enterprise, Alabama.
